description: One live X search over the pinned people's recent posts and clips; returns moments, each the person's own post with ONE clear claim, prediction or explanation, why this audience cares, and where in the clip it is. `handles` (X handles without @, 10-20 works best) replaces the pinned list; omit it to use the saved list. Takes up to ~2 minutes. Cost: the user's FIRST search is free and reads only the first 5 people (plan.free_find_available); after that 50 credits per search, reading everyone pinned — tell the user the cost and get a yes before a paid call. Then draft_quote_post for the moments the user likes. The user posts; never claim a post went out.

handles.description: X handles to pin, without @. Omit to search the saved list.

space_id.description: The content space (brand) to run it on — from list_content_spaces. No space yet? setup_content_space first.

topic.description: Only moments on this topic count, e.g. 'pricing'.

name: find_quote_moments
title: Find the pinned people's clearest claims on X
